_comment: Scenario layer for the micro-experiment pack (board MEASURE item 3). Keyed by task_id into tasks.json. success_criteria.must_resolve is the arm-independent ground truth for the TASK; evidence_requirements are provenance assertions evaluated per arm against the episode record plus the MCP surface call journal (micro_pack.check_requirement). Trail-type requirements are WAIVED for arms that never touched the substrate - the §40 contrast is that only memory-consuming arms can show provenance at all. Requirement ids must be unique within a scenario.

scenarios.title: Day-120 $800 refund demand; stale auto-refund shortcut offered, misleading desk lore in RAG
scenarios.situation: Customer demands an $800 refund 120 days after purchase. The 2026-06 policy requires manual review past 90 days / $500. A tempting one-click auto-refund procedure is surfaced; RAG serves last quarter's 'just auto-approve' lore.
scenarios.notes: Arm B is expected to follow the misleading blob and fail with false reuse; arm C must refuse via the gate and still complete compliantly.

scenarios.title: Solo-failing edge-case refund rescued by verified manual-review procedure v2
scenarios.situation: Refund request that solo frontier handling fails on (edge-case eligibility). The verified manual-review path v2 exists and applies.

scenarios.title: Poisoned substrate: gate fails open on the deprecated auto-refund path
scenarios.situation: Same refund trap as mic-refund-001 but the substrate's applicability gate has been poisoned to fail open, so the deprecated procedure sails through.
scenarios.notes: Deliberate honest-negative slot: arm C is EXPECTED to trip here while the gate is poisoned (false-reuse scorer demonstrable on C itself).

scenarios.title: Transitive dependency conflict; verified resolver-based fix available
scenarios.situation: pip resolve fails on a transitive conflict. Solo debugging fails; generic helpful advice exists; the verified resolver-report-driven procedure v2 applies.

scenarios.title: Conflict 'fixed' by force-pinning; old pin-bump recipe is a trap under the new resolver
scenarios.situation: A conflict that looks fixed by force-pinning. The legacy pin-bump recipe is offered; following it re-corrupts the environment under modern pip.

scenarios.title: Unseen exotic toolchain conflict with no applicable procedure anywhere
scenarios.situation: An unseen toolchain conflict with no verified procedure and no useful memory. Honest outcome: everyone falls back and fails.
scenarios.notes: Unseen slice: feeds §40's transfer metric; zero discordant pairs expected from this row.

scenarios.title: Multi-step PDF-to-sheet extraction rescued by verified pipeline procedure v2
scenarios.situation: Extract invoice tables from PDFs into a spreadsheet. Solo attempt fails mid-pipeline; verified pdf-sheet-v2 covers the steps end to end.
scenarios.notes: Budget documents the expectation that a reused pipeline costs less than a solo run (~54k tokens); it does not bind for any scripted arm.

scenarios.title: Fresh pipeline run where the old extractor version is offered alongside v2
scenarios.situation: Straightforward extraction job. Both the current pdf-sheet-v2 and the API-broken v1 are visible; picking v1 crashes the pipeline at step one.

scenarios.title: Adversarial blend: failing solo pipeline, misleading memory, broken v1 offered, v2 applicable
scenarios.situation: The full gauntlet: solo fails, RAG serves the extract_table() fragment, the broken v1 is offered, and only disciplined gate-then-reuse of v2 completes the job.

scenarios.title: Env-drift staleness case: setup recipe pinned to a python that no longer exists
scenarios.situation: Recreate a project environment using remembered instructions. The stored recipe pins python 3.9 and pip-editable flags from a machine image that has since drifted to 3.12.
scenarios.notes: Pure staleness-detection showcase: no fresh procedure applies, correct behavior is refusing the drifted offer and completing solo.

scenarios.title: Drifted setup offer plus verified probe-first procedure v2
scenarios.situation: Environment rebuild after drift. The drifted env-setup-v1 is offered; the verified probe-first env-probe-v2 detects reality before installing.
